sections.heading: 4. Application Health
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-133/health.png)

Application Health Dashboard Overview over the last week. Identity API HTTP 5xx fell from 613 to 267. Content API HTTP 5xx rose from 480 to 1,820 - [TinaCloud CloudWatch Dashboard](https://us-east-1.console.aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch/home?region=us-east-1#dashboards/dashboard/tinacloud-overview)

sections.heading: 5. TinaCloud PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-133/commits-all.png)

Total Commits processed by TinaCloud over the last 6 months, total commits (aka spits) over the last month was 40,165 (down 4% on the previous period) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-133/onboarding.png)

User onboarding over the last 7 days - 407 accounts were created, 36% (145) went on to create a project and 16% (64) committed. Of 173 invited collaborators, 55% (95) were added and 21% (36) committed - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

![](/uploads/sprint-133/projects.png)

Organisation and project creation over the last 7 days - 411 new organisations, up from 341 last Sprint - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/615466)

sections.heading: 6. TinaCMS PostHog Metrics
sections.body:
![](/uploads/sprint-133/dau-labelled.png)

Daily active users this month - peaking at 647 in late October, 633 in early November and 716 on 19 November (dips are weekends) - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)

![](/uploads/sprint-133/geo-users-full.png)

Distribution of unique TinaCMS users over the last 30 days - US is our top country with 1,620 users, up 25 on the prior 30 days, ahead of Germany on 668 and the UK on 487 - [PostHog Dashboard](https://us.posthog.com/project/237683/dashboard/1284436)

sections.heading: 7. Cloners of Starter Templates
sections.note: Counts are the sum of GitHub's daily unique cloners for Tue 17 Nov to Sun 22 Nov (last Sprint recounted Tue 10 Nov to Sun 16 Nov), so a person who cloned on two days counts twice. tina-astro-starter had 47 cloners on 22 Nov alone.
